common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

home.subtitle: Tell us where you want to go, the way you'd tell a friend. One of our agents puts the options together and answers you right here — no forms, no fuss.
home.feature1Body: Give us the origin, the destination and the dates however you like. We handle the rest.
home.feature2Body: Your options are put together by hand, by people who know the routes and talk to the airlines.
home.feature3Body: Close the page whenever you like. We'll email you, and the conversation picks up where it left off.

chat.title: Your conversation · WeeFly Concierge
chat.greeting: Hello! Tell me where you'd like to travel, when, and how many of you are going. I'll then pass your request to one of our agents, who'll put the options together.
chat.suggestion2: I want to go to Boston in September, 2 adults and a child
chat.sendFailed: I couldn't send that message. Would you try again?
chat.awaitingAgent: Your request is with an agent. As soon as the options are ready they'll appear here — and we'll email you, so feel free to close the page.
chat.personalLink: This address is personal. Please don't share it — it gives access to your travel request.
chat.requestRegistered: Request logged under reference {reference}. An agent will put the options together and let you know by email.
chat.chosenOption: You chose: {name}. Passport details are still to be filled in.
chat.assistantUnavailable: The assistant isn't available right now. Leave us your email and an agent will get back to you.
chat.processingProblem: I had trouble processing that. Could you say it again?
chat.fallbackReply: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you tell me the origin, the destination and the travel date?
chat.engineUnavailable: The conversation service is unavailable right now.
chat.searchFailed: I couldn't search for flights right now. Try again shortly.
chat.noFlights: I didn't find any flights for this search. Would you like to try other dates?

chatProposal.footnote: Choosing takes you to the passport details. You can come back and switch options until you pay.
chatProposal.defaultIntro_one: I've put together one option for your trip. See what you think.
chatProposal.defaultIntro_other: I've put together {count} options for your trip. See which suits you best.
chatProposal.revisedIntro: I've revised the figures on your proposal. These are the updated options.

linkUnavailable.notFoundBody: This link doesn't exist or is no longer available. Check that you copied the whole address, or get in touch with our team.
linkUnavailable.lockedBody: Our team hasn't opened this step yet. As soon as it's ready, you'll be told to come back here.
linkUnavailable.expiredBody: This link is no longer active. Contact our team for a new one.
linkUnavailable.unavailableBody: We couldn't open this page right now. Please try again in a moment.

request.title: Request your trip
request.subtitle: Tell us where you want to go and our Concierge team handles the rest — with the best options and fares, tailored to you.
request.alreadyBody: We've already received this travel request. Our Concierge team is putting the best options together and will be in touch.

proposal.title_one: We found one option for your trip
proposal.title_other: We found {count} options for your trip
proposal.defaultIntro: Open each option to see the full itinerary, the baggage included and a detailed price breakdown.
proposal.discloseOpen: See the full itinerary, conditions and price breakdown
proposal.includesTaxes: Includes taxes and the WeeFly service fee
proposal.personalLink_one: This link is personal. Please don't share it: it gives access to your passenger's details.
proposal.personalLink_other: This link is personal. Please don't share it: it gives access to your passengers' details.
proposal.validityTitle: The prices below are guaranteed until {deadline}
proposal.validityBody: After that the airline may change the fare and we'll have to reconfirm the amount. If you need more time, talk to your agent.
proposal.validityExpiredBody: The airline may have changed the fare. Pick the option you prefer anyway — we'll reconfirm the amount before asking you to pay.
proposal.priceLockFeeNote: Holds the price beyond its validity
proposal.priceCurrencyNote: Amounts in {currency}. Payment is made by link or bank transfer, with instructions in the next step.
proposal.preparingBody: Your agent is revising the figures right now. Keep this link — as soon as it's ready the options will appear here and we'll email you.
proposal.doneBody: We've received your choice and the passenger details. Our team will be in touch with the next steps.

passengers.title: Passenger details
passengers.subtitle: Write the names exactly as they appear in the passport. Once the ticket is issued, correcting a name means reissuing it, and the airline charges for that.
passengers.alreadyBody: We have the passenger details. Our team will be in touch with the next steps.
passengers.missingChoiceTitle: You still need to choose a flight
passengers.missingChoiceBody: Before filling in passport details, choose one of the options your agent put together.

payment.title: Payment
payment.arrangingBody: Your agent will be in touch with the payment method. If you'd rather get ahead, write to us at {email}.
payment.declareHint: This tells our team to go and check. It isn't a confirmation.
payment.declaredBody: As soon as we confirm the payment has come in, you'll get an email and we'll start issuing the tickets.
payment.confirmedBody: Thank you! We've received your payment of {amount}. We'll issue the tickets and send them to your email.
payment.issuedBody: It's all done. The tickets have been sent to your email — check your spam folder too if you can't find them.
payment.awaitingFareBody: Our team is settling the best fare for your trip. As soon as it's ready the amount appears on this very page — keep the link.
payment.noValueYet: There's no amount to pay on this request yet.
payment.declareThanks: Thank you — we'll confirm and let you know.

admin.noAccessBody: The account {email} isn't part of the platform team, so it has no access to the back-office.
admin.noAccessHint: To grant access, run this in the Supabase SQL editor:
admin.listSubtitle: Every client served over chat gets their own link and reference. Here you create the link, follow where the client stopped, and resend when needed.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Reference, name, email, route or token
admin.emptyAllHint: Click “New service link” to create the first one.
admin.newCaseCreatedHint: Copy and paste it into the conversation. The case is already in the list at E0.
admin.newCaseStage1Hint: where they're going, dates, who travels
admin.newCaseStage3Hint: only shows an amount once you set one
admin.newCaseStage2PendingHint: — doesn't exist yet. It appears once you put the options together in the Offers tab and hit Publish and notify client, which emails the address to the client.
admin.newCaseWarning: These links give access to passenger details. Send them only to the client, in the conversation where you served them. Never in groups.
admin.linkLockedTitle: {name} — not generated yet. Publish the proposal in the Offers tab.
admin.noPassengersYet: No details yet. The client fills them in after choosing an option in
admin.issueHint: Send the tickets to the client and mark as issued.
admin.payAutoHint: The amount lands here on its own once the client picks an option in the
admin.payManualHint: . If the case was closed outside the platform, record it by hand below — until then the Pay link tells the client the fare is still being prepared.
admin.payClientDeclared: The client says they've paid, on {when}. Confirm the money has come in before marking it received — the declaration is theirs, the confirmation is yours.
admin.payNotConfigured: WeePay isn't connected yet (WEEPAY_API_URL is missing), so there's no automatic link. Arrange payment with the client and record it here when the money arrives.
admin.convProposalDelivered: Proposal R{revision} delivered in the conversation.
admin.composerLocked: Revision R{revision} is published and therefore locked. To change itineraries or prices, open a revision in the panel on the right — the client is told about the change.
admin.composerEmpty: No option has been put together yet. Create the first one and write in the itinerary the airline gave you.
admin.composerNewOfferHint: · or duplicate an existing one to vary the fare
admin.composerNoProposal: Couldn't open this case's proposal. Check that migration 0005 has been applied to the database.
admin.composerOfferName: Option name · e.g. Cabo Verde Airlines · via Sal
admin.composerNoOutbound: The outbound has no legs. Without them the option can't be published.
admin.composerNoInbound: No inbound legs — this stays a one-way trip.
admin.composerRowServiceNote: Line the client sees · filled in by hand
admin.composerRowLockNote: Charged only if the client asks to hold the price beyond its validity
admin.composerCostNote: Internal, never visible to the client
admin.composerNoteHint: Appears on the card, below the itinerary
admin.composerNotePlaceholder: Write as you'd speak in chat. Explain why, not just what.
admin.composerLockedFields: Fields locked while revision R is published.
admin.previewLive: Updates as you type. Reflects the open option.
admin.previewEmpty: Open an option to preview it.
admin.publishNoOffers: Put at least one option together before publishing.
admin.publishMessagePlaceholder: Isaura, I found 3 options. The first is the one I'd recommend for the arrival time.
admin.publishWarning: On publishing, the case moves to E2 · Options sent, link 2 is generated and the client can choose and fill in passports. The offers are then locked: to change prices later, you create revision R{next} and the client is notified of the change.
admin.publishAutoSave: The draft saves itself as you type.
admin.publishedBody: Revision R{revision} went out{when}. The client can now open link 2 and choose.
admin.publishedChosen: The client has already chosen an option. Changing prices now forces them to review that choice.
admin.publishedRevisionHint: Opening a revision unlocks editing. While it's open the client sees a waiting message instead of the old prices.
admin.briefNoRequest: The client hasn't filled in link 1 yet. You can put the proposal together anyway — the totals assume 1 adult until the request arrives.
admin.noteInternal: Internal note — visible to the team only…
admin.phDocuments: Passport valid 6 months + ESTA or US visa

validation.lastNameMin: Surname must be at least 2 characters

validation.consentRequired: You need to accept this to continue

auth.confirmEmailHelp: Didn't get the email? Check your spam folder or click resend.
auth.confirmedBody: Your account is active. The next step is to sign in and create your first company — supplier, agent, or both.
auth.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid

auth.resetBody: Enter your account email. We'll send you a link to set a new password.

auth.newPasswordBody: Set the new password for the account name@company.cv
auth.strengthHint: add a symbol to reach excellent

onboarding.typeSubtitle: Each company has a single type. If you do more than one, you'll create a company for each — with its own details and reputation.
onboarding.typeAgentNote: Want to act as an agent (booking for others)? You don't need to choose that here — every user gets the agent area included.
onboarding.rentalBody: Your own fleet, with daily rates and pick-up and drop-off points.
onboarding.housingBody: Houses and rooms with nightly rates, calendar and house rules.
onboarding.tourismBody: Trips, activities and experiences with schedules and capacity.
onboarding.dataSubtitle: Fill in the tax and contact details. The company goes live straight away.

nav.footerBody: Reach every company without a PIN. Team management (RBAC) is coming soon.

dashboard.emptyBody: Your account is ready. To put services on the platform, the first step is to create a company — a provider (cars, houses or tours) or an agent. You can have several, all reachable with this one login.
dashboard.step1Body: Tax details, contacts and type of service. It goes live straight away.
dashboard.step2Body: Cars, houses or tours — one at a time, with photos and rules.
dashboard.step3Body: Searchable on WeeFly and on every channel connected by API.
dashboard.agentNoteTitle: Going to act as an agent too?
dashboard.agentNoteBody: The agent area is already included in your account — switch mode in the side menu whenever you like.
dashboard.agentSubtitle: Book for other people and keep track of your commissions.
dashboard.settingsSubtitle: Tax details, contacts and bank information.
dashboard.walletBody: Follow your balance, the commission on each booking and what you can withdraw.
dashboard.clientsBody: The clients you book for show up here, with their history and contact details.
dashboard.reviewsBody: Client reviews after each booking will appear here and count towards the company's reputation.
dashboard.calendarBody: Set availability, seasons and prices per day or per night. Available as soon as you create the first product.
dashboard.financeBody: Follow revenue, payments and transfers. The figures appear after the first completed booking.
dashboard.productsBody: Add cars, houses or tours — one at a time, with photos, prices and rules.
dashboard.bookingsBody: When clients book your products, the bookings show up here to be managed.

email.confirmSubject: We've received your travel request · WeeFly Concierge
email.confirmBody: {greeting} {name}, thank you for choosing WeeFly. We confirm we have your travel request. Our {concierge} team will get back to you shortly with the best flight options and fares, picked in detail for you.
email.confirmNoAction: There is nothing else to do right now. One of our specialists will contact you on the email or phone number you gave us.
email.confirmFooter: This message was sent by WeeFly Concierge because a travel request was submitted at weefly.africa. If you don't recognise this request, please ignore this email.
email.confirmTextIntro: We've received your travel request. Our Concierge team will get back to you shortly with the best flight options and fares.
email.proposalHeading_one: We found one option for you
email.proposalIntroRevised: We've revised the figures on your proposal. The options below replace the ones we sent you.
email.proposalIntro_one: We've put together one option for your trip. Open the link to see the full itinerary, the baggage included and the detailed price.
email.proposalIntro_other: We've put together {count} options for your trip. Open the link to see the full itinerary, the baggage included and the detailed price of each one.

email.proposalFooter: You're getting this message because you asked WeeFly for a travel quote. If you have questions, reply to this email and you'll be talking to your agent directly.
email.proposalTextPersonal: This address is personal. Don't share it.

email.paidNext: We'll now issue the tickets and send them to this same address. There is nothing else for you to do.
